column1: # The mask banks: one per semantic group, each a mask of its own on the row its group describes. A value's bit in its
# bank is its frozen slot in the bank's list (manifest/slots/LIST.tsv), so a bit never moves; width is the room the bank
# keeps for values still to be appended. Banks are never packed together: what a bit means is its bank's, not its place.
#   group: lexical (what a word is: part of speech, sense), structural (a role inside a structure: a dependency relation,
#          a thematic role), kind (what a row is)
#   carrier: entity (the entity's row), occurrence (a vertex of a layer: the token in its sentence, the argument in its
# Appending a bank, or widening one, is the only change; a bank is never renamed, narrowed or removed.
